Another narration states that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "From the time Rasulullaah ﷺ arrived in Madinah until the time he passed away, he was never able to eat barley bread to his fill for three consecutive days."

Yet another narration from Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) states that until Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, the family of Rasulullaah ﷺ were never able to fill themselves with bread made of wheat flour for two consecutive days.

A third narration from the same source quotes the following words of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA): "When Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, he could not fill himself with even the two black things, dates and water."[^2]

A narration of Bayhaqi states that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ never filled himself for three consecutive days though we would do so if we pleased because he always preferred others above himself (and would give others rather than eat himself)."[^3]
The Difficult life that Rasulullaah ﷺ Led

Hadhrat Hasan (RA) says, "Rasulullaah ﷺ used to assist people personally and even patch his clothing with pieces of leather. Until his demise, he could never eat both lunch and dinner for three consecutive days."[^4]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) says that until he passed away, Rasulullaah ﷺ never ate on a table and never ate bread made from finely ground flour. Another narration states that Rasulullaah ﷺ never even saw a roasted kid (a specially prepared delicacy during those times).[^5]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that many consecutive nights would pass by Rasulullaah ﷺ when his family would be hungry without anything to eat for dinner. The bread they ate most often was made from barley.[^6]

Hadhrat Abu Hurayra (RA) once passed by some people who were busy eating a roasted goat. When they invited him to eat, he refused saying, "Rasulullaah ﷺ left this world without being able to eat his fill of even barley bread."[^7]

Hadhrat Anas (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Faatima (RA) once gave Rasulullaah ﷺ piece of barley bread to eat, he said, "This is the first food your father has eaten in three days." A narration of Tabraani adds that Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "What is this?" Hadhrat Faatima (RA) said, "I baked a loaf of bread and could not allow myself to eat it until I brought you this piece." Rasulullaah ﷺ then told her what is mentioned above.[^8]
